title: What CAP Theorem Internals Is All About
description: Consistency, Availability, Partition tolerance: pick two — properly understood.. This database covers CAP Theorem Internals with full records: definitions, key facts, working procedures, and runnable demo programs, arranged on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. Consistency models form a spectrum from eventual to strict.
